# proxmox_node_apt_versions (Data Source)

Lists installable package versions of one node from `/nodes/{node}/apt/versions`, sorted by package. `old_version` is set when an upgrade is available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_apt_versions" "node1" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `packages` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packages))
